notes.title: Announcement of the launch of the Early Access Version
notes.notes: Hello, I'm Valkyrie Yang Xuan, I'm glad to tell you that the Oriental Moon Rabbit Rhapsody Sneak Peek will be officially launched on November 11th at 12:00, when the trial version will be discontinued, with a 30% discount on the first release, which will last for two weeks!
